<!-- PROTOTYPE v2 — fact sheet. Throwaway. -->

::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In development]{.proto-status .s-dev}

What it is
: A search tool for finding BigPicture datasets that match what you need, by their metadata. From the results you apply for access in [REMS](rems.qmd). For now it covers clinical datasets only. Later it will support Dataset on Demand: picking images from several datasets and applying for them as one.

Who it's for
: Researchers looking for data.

Provided by
: CSC

Before you start
: An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login, with membership of your organisation's [Perun](perun.qmd) group.

How to get access
: Sign in at [discovery.bigpicture.eu](https://discovery.bigpicture.eu).

Guides
: [None yet]{.proto-none}

Terms and privacy
: [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-help}
  [servicedesk@bigpicture.eu](mailto:servicedesk@bigpicture.eu){.proto-mail}
  :::

Estimated response time
: 3 working days

Related services
: [REMS](rems.qmd), [Landing pages](landing-pages.qmd) (no login needed), [Repository](repository.qmd), [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd)

Source code
: [sd-search-ui](https://github.com/CSCfi/sd-search-ui), [sd-search-api](https://github.com/CSCfi/sd-search-api)
:::
